summary: Complaints centre on waterlogged rural roads, blocked drainage and broken village roads, plus stalled sugarcane dues and a stalled rural economy; appreciation is thin and mostly inferred.

positives.english: Shakumbhari Devi shrine at Jasmor gives the area its own identity.
positives.hindi: शाकुंभरी देवी धाम से इलाके की अलग पहचान है
positives.basis: Inference: 4pm.co.in mentions Jasmor as the location of the Shakumbhari Devi Shaktipeeth only as historical background; no voter praise for it was found in the source.

positives.english: Department says action on the village drain is under way.
positives.hindi: विभाग का कहना है कि नाले पर कार्रवाई चल रही है
positives.basis: District-level: PWD Executive Engineer Dharmendra Singh said action in the Hauzkheri drain matter is underway ("कार्रवाई प्रचलित है"). Village block and whether it lies in the Dehat seat are not confirmed.

positives.english: Residents have a steady local market for daily needs.
positives.hindi: रोजमर्रा का सामान गांव के आसपास ही मिल जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: no source found for this; the 4pm.co.in trader quote describes business as stalled, which points the other way. Included only as a placeholder positive to be verified in the field.

positives.english: Rural belt is seeing some local development attention.
positives.hindi: देहात में अब कुछ विकास कार्य पर ध्यान जा रहा है
positives.basis: Inference: no source found that voters praise development here; 4pm.co.in residents say development is missing. Placeholder only, to be verified in the field.

positives.english: Sugarcane mills are operating and the cane crop still has a buyer.
positives.hindi: गन्ना अभी भी मिलों तक पहुंच रहा है, खरीद चल रही है
positives.basis: Inference: ChiniMandi (May 2026) reports the Saharanpur protest over dues but names no mill and gives no figure; the mills operating is implied, not stated. Placeholder only, to be verified in the field.

negatives.english: Mohaddipur village road is completely broken and hard to leave.
negatives.hindi: मोहद्दीपुर गांव की सड़क एकदम टूटी है, निकलना मुश्किल है
negatives.basis: Saharanpur Dehat-specific: a resident of Mohaddipur village says the road is completely broken and that it is hard to leave the village. Article is one-sided political framing (opposition-leaning quotes, no reply from the government).

negatives.english: Rain leaves knee-deep water on village roads in Mohaddipur.
negatives.hindi: बारिश में मोहद्दीपुर की सड़क पर घुटनों तक पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Saharanpur Dehat-specific: residents say rain causes knee-deep water on the Mohaddipur road. Same article as the road complaint.

negatives.english: Highway soil has blocked village drainage in Hauzkheri for three years.
negatives.hindi: हाईवे की मिट्टी से हौजखेड़ी का पानी तीन साल से नहीं निकल रहा
negatives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur): soil dumped on Delhi-Yamunotri SH-57 has blocked the Hauzkheri village drainage for about three years; a water channel at khasra 343 is closed, water collects near homes and fields. Block and whether it lies in the Dehat seat not confirmed.

negatives.english: Overnight rain floods rural roads and stops drainage across the district's villages.
negatives.hindi: देहात में रातभर की बारिश से सड़कों पर जलभराव, निकासी बाधित
negatives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur rural belt): Amar Ujala reports overnight rain left low-lying areas and roads under water and affected drainage in several places; no village named.

negatives.english: Sugarcane dues from last season and this one are still unpaid.
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का पिछले और इस सीजन का बकाया भुगतान अब भी अटका है
negatives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur): farmers protested at the Saharanpur Sugarcane Department over outstanding dues from the current and previous crushing seasons; no amount stated; officials asked for time until June 1, 2026. No mill named.

notes: Positives 3-5 are placeholders with no supporting source (inference: true); they are weak and need field verification. Only 2 negatives are Dehat-village-specific (Mohaddipur, from one political opinion article); 3 are district-level (Hauzkheri drain, rural waterlogging, sugarcane dues). Block/village membership of Hauzkheri and the rural waterlogging report is not confirmed as inside the Dehat seat. Hindi name 'सहारनपुर देहात' is the standard form, not taken from a fetched source. Identity: Wikipedia lists AC 4 as 'Saharanpur' (reserved: None, district Saharanpur) and the AC article as 'Saharanpur Dehat'; AC 3 is Saharanpur Nagar, AC 4 is the rural seat. Not used: Amar Ujala/Patrika/Newstrack pieces on Ashu Malik's 32-village waterlogging list (newstrack returned HTTP 403; Amar Ujala sugar-arrears piece undated), and tv9up (SP internal dispute, no local issue). Search budget was exhausted after roughly 11 WebSearch calls, so the Jasmor/electricity/school/health/water-supply searches could not be run. Recommended next steps: Dainik Jagran and Live Hindustan Saharanpur rural pages, Amar Ujala Saharanpur Dehat village coverage, and Nagar Nigam/Gram Panchayat notices for Mohaddipur and Hauzkheri.
